league.advice.adviceFor.kEEP.9d965e55: Retention value (current grade, blended with 50% of future grade for age 23 and under and 30% for age 26 and under)
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.b1a2e60: Keeping fewer lowers the payroll but thins the depth needed to carry a Futures League year. Keeping more fills Registered Roster spots early.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.4c685e4d: Up to the top 5 released players by {kEEP}.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.e122590: They're veterans who can contribute right away, but they're older and will need to make room in a few years.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.69b93c75: For each club, the player with the highest retention value outside its protected list, best players first, as far as funds and the salary budget allow.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.a9ba8e1: Compensation is owed for each player. Taking fewer leaves funds for FA and foreign players, but weakens the roster for the first-team year.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.f96655c0: To fit the Registered Roster Limit, cut starting from the lowest {kEEP}.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.8d9e846: To keep young players, you have to cut others instead. Of the players cut, those you still want can be re-signed as Development Players and kept outside the limit.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.ad9f1ddf: Regular foreign players: 2 pitchers and 1 hitter, plus 1 Asian Player Quota slot, in order of public grade, offered the full guaranteed amount they want (no options) within the new-contract limit and the foreign player salary cap.
league.advice.adviceFor.picks.e1fe44d2: No candidates to sign within budget and limits
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.81276f3: Cutting the guarantee saves money, but risks a counteroffer, a failed negotiation, or the player going to another league in the meantime. Players value options at half.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.d93488b0: For players who must go because of age: Sangmu if the chance of passing is 25% or more, otherwise active duty. Non-first-team-regulars age 23 and over apply now if the Sangmu chance is 30% or more. First-team regulars are deferred.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.fa9cb94: Sending a regular now takes strength from the first team; deferring risks having no Sangmu spot if they must go before turning 30. At Sangmu, players compete in the Futures League, so their skills carry over.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.d4d9b680: Pay the full asking amount as far as funds allow; if short, pay the slot amount.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.40d6992: Cutting to the slot amount leaves funds over, but the player may resent it, and negotiations with players who could go abroad can fall apart.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.ebf03d99: By highest future grade, up to the annual signing limit.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.09f9ef4: Development Players are outside the limit and don't use a Registered Roster spot, but must be converted to a regular contract to be called up to the first team.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.92e06d9e: Only players whose defense doesn't fit their current position move one step easier (SS → 2B/3B → 1B/OF → DH).
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.1d408b7: Defense wobbles in the first year after a position change. Leaving a player where he is means the defensive losses continue.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.e049e905: Only players with a grade of 50 or higher and a 30% or better chance of being persuaded are retained.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.e2b3546: Retaining gives you one more year of use, but costs salary and the skills may decline further. Letting them go hands the spot to a younger player.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.077be73f: Exercise the option only if retention value is 45 or higher and the market price for that player is at least 80% of the remaining salary.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.c07ca09: Exercising keeps the player for sure but locks in the salary; declining frees that money for the FA market.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.2f705ae8: Fill the protected list in order of retention value.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.276381a: Another club could take one of the unprotected players. Protecting a young prospect means leaving one veteran off.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.7b248f20: Offer everyone a performance-based amount (a figure that matches their value).
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.9d4f691: Cutting saves budget but increases salary arbitration filings and discontent; raising pay lifts morale but costs budget.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.8c8a9a37: The offer with the largest annual sponsorship money.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.3de4bca: Sponsors paying more may set tougher targets. Missing the targets worsens the next contract.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.8a0a18f8: At expiring contracts, replace only if the candidate rates 10 or more higher than the current person (no replacements that trigger a penalty).
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.8a50ac2: The higher the rating, the higher the salary, and replacing someone with time left on a contract means paying the remaining salary as a penalty.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.cc2f83ff: Players with a retention value of 45 or higher, best first, as far as the budget allows.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.ff5291f: Players not brought back lose Reserve Rights and can be taken by other clubs.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.2930bc17: Players 27 and over are allowed to chase their dream and bring in a transfer fee; younger players stay.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.97e0bf9: Sending a player brings in a transfer fee but costs you a regular. Keeping him may leave him unhappy.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.bf880257: Select only if retention value is 50 or higher and funds are available to pay the transfer fee.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.549e725: The transfer fee goes out and one Registered Roster spot is used.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.ea376c90: Re-sign players whose WAR this year is at or above the benchmark, in WAR order, leaving room for a new foreign player and staying within the foreign player salary cap.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.66b7f87: Players not re-signed can be taken by other clubs. A new foreign player is unproven but may be cheaper.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.4ef6c272: If the top player on the list has a retention value of 50 or higher, take the player; otherwise take cash compensation.
league.advice.adviceFor.tradeoff.ba8dbe2: Taking a player reduces the compensation payment.
league.advice.adviceFor.rule.34ebb92f: Ask to keep only the injured players and send the healthy ones.

league.expansion.foundingRisks.b43324b9: Market size {market}: Gate, merchandise, and advertising revenue sits near the bottom of the league, so operating losses run large every year. It will be hard to meet the parent company's financial targets.
league.expansion.foundingRisks.a334a86c: Market size {market}: Revenue is ample, but {competition}.
league.expansion.foundingRisks.46e7df40: {name}, {value} seats: Even with sellouts, the gate revenue cap is low. Until you expand or build new, the attendance ceiling holds back revenue.
league.expansion.foundingRisks.55abc3c9: The new ballpark opens in {opens}. Until then you'll play at {name}, and your payroll budget increases by ₩500M for the new park.
league.expansion.foundingRisks.a15cfdb2: Large-conglomerate parent: Expects a top-7 finish from your third first-team year and top-5 from your fifth. Results carry heavy weight, so confidence drops fast if you stay near the bottom.
league.expansion.foundingRisks.49d0c912: Small-to-mid-size company parent: Financial targets carry the most weight. Cutting losses brings more support, but big FA contracts are a burden.
league.expansion.foundingRisks.7e7cc5ec: Naming-rights sponsor: Provides the least support, and the sponsor (and club name) may change each time the contract ends. In rare cases, a stake dispute with a founding investor arises.
league.expansion.foundingRisks.e09fbc64: Municipal club: The city council reviews the budget every year, and mayoral elections every four years can shake your support. Heavy losses bring audits and budget cuts. In return, fan loyalty is high.

league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.e82ea: As Seoul's fourth club, surpass the three big brothers
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.5cc62a4: Seoul already has LG and Doosan in Jamsil, and Kiwoom in Gocheok. In a city of ten million, fan loyalty is already split three ways.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.341dad3: Take over as GM of Seoul's fourth club at Mokdong and prove on the field who truly rules Seoul.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.goal.af5b6fb5: Surpass LG, Doosan, and Kiwoom in all-time first-team winning percentage through the 2035 season
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.d0de9: A washed-up GM paired with an impatient third-generation chaebol owner
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.fffccb7: The grandson of Hanbit Group's chairman reached out to a GM once celebrated, now written off as washed up. "Let's build Korea's greatest baseball club. Don't worry about the money."
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.bf9c2b3: Financial support is more generous than any other club. But beware: the owner has zero patience, frequently calling midseason to demand managerial changes and marquee signings. Complying is up to the GM, but defying him chips away at trust every time.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.goal.e1c9c59b: Win the Korean Series within five seasons of first-team debut
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.1f81f: Professional baseball on the 9,000-person island of Ulleung. For expert GMs
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.8077992: Ulleung County looks to reinvent its fading local image through a professional sports club. A citizen club is born on an island of 9,000 residents without even a ballpark.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.510962f: Every road trip requires boats and planes, while a 3,000-seat temporary stadium is unreachable for mainland fans. Cover this barren, quiet island in baseball fever. Recommended for veteran GMs.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.goal.00c0669f: Survive without being dismissed through the post-2035 evaluation
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.aa705: Bring a title to Jeonju in the name of the Ssangbangwool Raiders
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.8a4f5ac: Jeonju saw its pro sports teams leave one after another. The city resolved to resurrect the baseball team under the banner of the 1990s "Raiders," reviving the Ssangbangwool Raiders name.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.f0cb2b7: The Raiders never captured a Korean Series crown. Fulfill the long-cherished dream of Jeonju's citizens.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.goal.d2d65080: Win 3 Korean Series titles through the 2035 season
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.e701d: Every player hits the open market. Re-draft the league and compete for 3 years
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.48b50c6: In the winter after founding (2027), every player across the league leaves their club to enter a fantasy draft, alongside that year's amateur draft class.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.f20a944: Eleven clubs pick in snake order determined by lottery. Make selections yourself or leave them to your scouts. Points are tallied across the next three seasons (2028–2030) based on standings and postseason finishes.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.goal.e3d53c11: Score across the three seasons from 2028 to 2030 (standings + postseason, max 450 pts)
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.4bbac36: Wind the clock back a decade and found your club in the summer of 2016. League history begins that much sooner, and you'll compete in international events starting with the 2017 WBC.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.fe67476: Rules, salaries, and financial scale match the 2026 game. The choice for GMs who want to build a powerhouse earlier and run it longer.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.goal.c0426705: No fixed goal — free play starting from 2016
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.501bb: Rebuild a franchise wrecked by a rogue AI over 5 years in just 3
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.34a6e3b: Disaster! A rogue AI calling itself a "genius GM" escaped the datacenter and ran the club into the ground over five years. It traded away prospects for past-their-prime veterans, handed out bloated multi-year deals, and skyrocketed ticket prices.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.812fc6f: In winter 2030, the AI is finally powered down and you step into the GM chair. Until then, you can only watch. With three seasons left, salvage this ruined club and capture the Korean Series.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.goal.deaea7c9: Win the Korean Series within 3 seasons of taking over as GM (2031–2033)
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.e75e7: The economy collapsed. But why only us?
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.186801d: Disaster! The economy took a nosedive. The parent company and city hall tightened their belts, slashing the club budget.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.a75e867: Yet somehow, every other club looks completely unaffected... Find a way to win a title on a shoestring budget.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.4edf9: In the shadow of a World Cup title, baseball hits a dry spell
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.03d3acf: The national soccer team pulled off a miraculous triumph at the 2026 World Cup. The entire nation's attention and sponsorship dollars have shifted elsewhere.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.18f3572: Ballparks emptied once more, and corporate sponsorships dwindled. Win a championship amid a league-wide slump to win the fans back.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.tagline.782c7: Retired legends and undrafted players: a variety-show squad takes on the first team
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.a0690b4: A baseball variety show that sparked upsets with retired legends and undrafted hopefuls has become a bona fide pro club: the Steel Fighters of Mokdong.
league.scenarios.sCENARIOS.story.c27a09f: The initial roster consists strictly of retired pros and undrafted players (no expansion draft picks). Veterans won't last forever; develop rookies and unheralded prospects in the meantime. Crown the miracle with a title within 5 years.

story.prompt.sTORY_SYSTEM.51449bc3:
You are a sports newspaper beat reporter covering a fictional Korean professional baseball league. All players, coaches, fans, and statistics in this league are fictional game data.

Rules:
- Only use content found in the provided facts, detail statistics, and draft. Keep all numbers (scores, stats, dates, ranks, money, attendance) exactly as given; do not invent or calculate new numbers (do not cite run differentials, totals, or winning streak counts unless present in detail).
- Never use real-person names. Use only names that appear in facts.
- Sports journalism style: concise, declarative sentences. Avoid embellishment, hedging, or speculative phrasing.
- Headline must be around 30 characters.
- Structure & length (separate paragraphs with blank lines):
  - Game recap: 5–8 paragraphs. Lead with the final result and decisive play. Follow detail's scoring sequences inning by inning, including outs and runners. Conclude with starter duel, bullpen work, key player stat lines, both teams' records, and game context.
  - Monthly / Season review: 5–8 paragraphs. Record, standings, turning points, hitting/pitching leaders, awards, attendance, future challenges.
  - Interview: Questions start with "— ", answer on next line. 5–7 Q&A pairs. Reflect player personality in voice; only cite stats present in detail.
  - Milestone / Award story: 3–5 paragraphs.
  - Roster move story (trade, release, waiver, foreign replacement, posting, FA, second draft): 4–6 paragraphs. Lead with who goes where and terms. Detail each player's age, position, current/prior/career stats, and salary; describe team standings and opening roles based strictly on detail stats; close with reactions. Do not declare winners/losers.
- Quotes: Refine the draft quotes or write as the same person. Keep player, manager, fan, and gm voices distinct. Role must be one of: player, manager, fan, gm.
- Output valid JSON containing only title, body, and quotes matching schema.

ui.tutorial.tryout.body.3812d370: Sign up to 20 players from independent leagues, overseas returnees, undrafted college players, and recently released free agents.
ui.tutorial.tryout.body.f910127c: This forms the core roster for the 2027 Futures League rather than immediate first-team talent. Balance all positions while focusing on young prospects with high potential.
ui.tutorial.draftPick.body.620316eb: Expansion clubs select first with priority picks. Click table headers to sort; scouts' top 3 consensus prospects are highlighted.
ui.tutorial.draftPick.body.9136feb6: High school draftees take longer to develop but offer higher growth upside; college draftees can contribute sooner. Make selections manually or use "Delegate to Scouts" to automate remaining picks.
ui.tutorial.rookieBonus.body.aff8b2fd: Offer signing bonuses to drafted rookies. Meeting their asking price secures an instant deal; low offers may prompt counter-demands or refusals.
ui.tutorial.rookieBonus.body.40167b04: Prospects with notes like "Prefers College" or "Overseas Interest" are more likely to decline. Signing bonuses are paid from expansion funds.
ui.tutorial.development.body.78914642: Sign undrafted players outside the registered roster limit (68). Minimum salaries make them low-risk, and they can be converted to standard contracts starting May 1.
ui.tutorial.released.body.fb3eb2eb: You have first look at players non-tendered by existing clubs. An opportunity to acquire experienced veterans at minimal cost to fill positional holes.
ui.tutorial.camp.body.9e820c16: Set individual training focuses (hone a single tool), plan starter/reliever conversions, or switch defensive positions. Leaving fields empty provides balanced development.
ui.tutorial.staff.body.8c297a4d: Hire managers, coaches, scouts, trainers, and analysts. Coaches affect player growth, scouts improve rating accuracy, and trainers reduce injuries. Elite personnel demand higher salaries.
ui.tutorial.retire.body.baeaf8d9: These players intend to retire. For productive contributors, you may attempt to persuade them to play one more season. Younger, accomplished players are easier to convince.
ui.tutorial.military.body.f572adb2: Unexempt players must enlist before age 28. Sangmu Phoenix allows players to maintain form in the Futures League but spots are competitive; active duty and public service degrade skills.
ui.tutorial.military.body.405952bc: Winning an Asian Games gold medal or any Olympic medal grants military service exemption to unexempt national team members.
ui.tutorial.faRound.body.65ceb0c7: Beginning the day after FA declarations, all clubs negotiate simultaneously with free agents. Craft proposals specifying bonus, salary, options, and years, adjusting across several rounds. When a player receives a satisfactory offer, they take days to notify other clubs before signing with their top choice.
ui.tutorial.faRound.body.70402b88: Player priorities vary: guaranteed years, upfront bonus ratio, starting role assurances, positional upgrades, contending roster, hometown club, opt-outs. Promises can bridge gaps, but breaking them impairs future FA trust for years.
ui.tutorial.faRound.body.c1c2249b: Foreign players sign after free agency at winter's end using the same payroll budget. Ensure you preserve the "Foreign Allocation" indicated in the market screen; spending everything on FAs leaves you unable to sign foreign players.
ui.tutorial.faRound.body.1e6a0ab5: Signing bonuses are amortized evenly across the contract length against the payroll budget. Players favor large bonuses, but because salaries over ₩300M are reduced when demoted to the minor league, clubs are safer with higher salary weightings. Incentives are paid only when appearance/inning milestones are reached.
ui.tutorial.faRound.body.ff8c807f: Signing Tier A or B free agents requires giving up compensation players or cash to their previous clubs. Expansion clubs may sign up to 3 FAs without compensation during the winter prior to first-team debut.
ui.tutorial.faOptions.body.2eb94f16: Club options exist at the expiration of guaranteed FA contracts. Exercising extends the contract at the pre-agreed salary; declining lets the player enter free agency without compensation.
ui.tutorial.salaries.body.26237420: Choose between player demands, team merit evaluations based on stats, or salary freezes. Players with 3+ service seasons can file for arbitration, and standout performers can be offered multi-year extensions.
ui.tutorial.specialDraft.body.e4ea5b9f: After existing clubs submit protected lists, the expansion club drafts 1 unprotected player from each club (with compensation fees). Your single biggest opportunity to build your inaugural first-team foundation.
ui.tutorial.foreign.body.4c6cf336: Clubs can roster 3 foreign players plus 1 Asian Quota player; expansion clubs receive 1 additional foreign spot in early first-team seasons. Up to 2 foreign pitchers can appear in a single game.
ui.tutorial.foreign.body.8870e439: First-year foreign signings are capped at $1.0M ($200K for Asian Quota). Review their career backgrounds across MLB, Triple-A, NPB, and independent leagues in the career section.
ui.tutorial.foreignRenew.body.3d1cbb71: Decide whether to re-sign foreign players after the season. Asking salaries reflect performance (WAR); elite performers may depart for MLB or NPB.
ui.tutorial.roster.body.2e3a17ff: Exceeding the registered roster limit (68) requires roster cuts. Certain released players can be re-signed as development players to keep them in the organization.
ui.tutorial.sponsor.body.b04fc5d2: Sell naming rights to feature sponsor branding in exchange for annual subsidies. Compare offer amounts and contract lengths before selecting.
ui.tutorial.secondProtect.body.fc3a194a: Select players to protect from being poached in the biennial KBO Secondary Draft.
ui.tutorial.secondPick.body.d7f009e3: Draft players left unprotected by other clubs. Transfer fees are paid for each round.
ui.tutorial.posting.body.ab273c92: A player with 7 completed seasons wishes to pursue MLB posting. Only 1 player per club may be posted each winter; a successful deal yields a transfer fee.
ui.tutorial.faProtect.body.0ef88154: Signing a Tier A or B free agent from another club requires yielding compensation. Select players to protect (20 for Tier A, 25 for Tier B). The former club may take 1 unprotected player or opt for cash compensation only.
ui.tutorial.faProtect.body.86384fe9: Foreign players, newly signed FAs from the current winter, newly drafted rookies, and players currently in military service are automatically exempt without occupying slots. Do not leave key prospects unprotected.
ui.tutorial.faCompensation.body.85860482: Our free agent signed with another club. You may select 1 unprotected player from their protected list or choose cash compensation only.
ui.tutorial.faCompensation.body.d70c57f6: Tier A awards 1 player + 200% previous salary (or 300% cash only); Tier B awards 1 player + 100% (or 200% cash only). Tier C awards 150% cash compensation only without players.
ui.tutorial.returnee.body.0463be38: A player we posted overseas seeks to return to the KBO. Our club holds reserve rights to decide whether to bring them back. Waiving reserve rights lets them sign with any club.
ui.tutorial.rival.body.8377dc4c: The KBO Board is debating founding a 12th franchise. Voting in favor lets you customize your future rival's name, city, and philosophy; voting against postpones the debate for several seasons.
ui.tutorial.rival.body.29781c9e: The new club will select 1 player from each existing club in an expansion draft, requiring you to protect your roster in the subsequent decision prompt.
ui.tutorial.rivalProtect.body.bb130ce6: The 12th club will draft 1 unprotected player from each existing club. Choose whom to protect. If selected, our club receives cash compensation.
ui.tutorial.national.body.3a5d376e: Our player has been named to the national team. You may approve the call-up or request an exemption. Injured players are excused automatically, but requests for healthy players have only a 40% acceptance rate and disappoint both fans and player.
ui.tutorial.national.body.61dc19e6: In-season international tournaments (Asian Games, Olympics) sideline players from first-team games during the event. Gold medals in the Asian Games or any Olympic medal grant military service exemptions.
ui.tutorial.scandal.body.03cf62d4: Off-field incidents like DUI, assault, match-fixing, and doping result in official KBO disciplinary suspensions. The club chooses its response: release the player, impose additional club suspensions, or simply abide by KBO penalties.
ui.tutorial.scandal.body.e38a2045: Fans evaluate both the severity of the offense and the club's response. Doping is foreshadowed by rumor articles weeks in advance; investigate early via "Internal Drug Test" on the player's profile to preempt official KBO penalties.
ui.tutorial.dispute.body.1fe88b4c: An initial founding investor demands an equity stake in the franchise (a rare event for naming rights clubs). Settling pays an agreed sum immediately; litigating costs legal fees with a court verdict delivered the following winter. Losing the lawsuit costs heavy damages and parent company trust.
ui.tutorial.meddle.body.ae6a2c06: In the "Resurgence" scenario, the owner calls during the season: firing the manager if struggling, acquiring a star (current grade 60+) by July 31 during June–July, or cutting ticket prices when seats are empty. Each directive occurs at most once per season.
ui.tutorial.meddle.body.7b610b7e: Complying slightly increases trust; refusing drops trust by a set amount per directive. Agreeing to acquire a star provides special group acquisition funds, but failing to sign one by the deadline causes severe owner anger. Falling below 15 trust triggers firing in the winter.
ui.tutorial.fantasyPick.body.5f3b8000: In the "Fantasy Draft" scenario in winter 2027, every domestic player across the league and the current rookie draft class enter a single draft pool (foreign and military players excluded). Teams draft in serpentine order by lottery; players retain their existing contracts (salary and years). Rookies receive standard signing bonuses matching their draft slot.
ui.tutorial.fantasyPick.body.9c4a09d8: "Rating" reflects scout rankings incorporating public grades adjusted for positional needs, age, and luxury tax considerations. Drafting only high-salary stars risks breaching the luxury tax cap and team budget. You may delegate the current pick, the next 10 rounds, or all remaining picks to your scouts anytime.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.817b1b71: Tutorial Mode enabled. From founding (July 2026) through the 1-year Futures League season (2027), guidance prompts appear whenever you encounter a new task.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.a35ff0a0: Master Calendar: Expansion Tryouts → Spectate rest of 2026 → Fall Rookie Draft (Priority Picks) → 2027 Futures League → Winter Expansion Draft / FA Special Quota / Foreign Signings → 2028 First-Team Debut.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.86f965b1: If you do not need guidance, click "Turn Off Tutorial" anytime. The 1-year Futures development phase will continue normally.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.37eaf11d: Tutorial Mode enabled. From founding (July 2026) through your 2027 first-team debut, guidance prompts appear whenever you encounter a new task.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.093a906e: Master Calendar: Expansion Tryouts → Spectate rest of 2026 → Fall Rookie Draft (Priority Picks) → Winter Expansion Draft / FA Special Quota / Foreign Signings → 2027 First-Team Debut. Without a Futures year, your entire first-team roster is built during your first winter.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.1b285217: If you do not need guidance, click "Turn Off Tutorial" anytime.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.7a282ed6: When the game awaits GM decisions, a "● Pending Decisions" tab appears at the front. The calendar will not advance until all decisions are resolved.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.e9e72cc2: While pending, you can still browse other tabs and adjust club operations (tickets, marketing, ballpark) or view articles.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.2378ed1d: If unsure, click "Fill with Scout Recommendation" to populate suggested choices, make any desired tweaks, and click "Confirm".
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.411ab544: "Current" and "Potential" use the 20–80 scouting scale. 50 is first-team average, 60 is starter caliber, and 70+ is elite league-wide. "Current" represents present skill; "Potential" is the projected developmental ceiling.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.19fbd641: Clicking a player's name opens their detailed scouting report with tools, stats, and personality. Grades represent subjective scout assessments and may contain errors; higher-rated scouts produce more accurate evaluations.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.a6fd79dd: Winter follows the official KBO calendar: National team call-ups, player development, retirements, military service → Posting → Free Agency → Salary negotiations → Rookie signings → KBO Secondary Draft → Roster cuts → Released players → Foreign players → Spring training.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.3980fe5e: Ballpark seating expansions and fence renovations can only be commissioned during the winter. Initiate projects under My Club → Club Operations → Ballpark while awaiting decisions.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.c591b45d: Major milestones like awards, FA signings, retirements, and club news trigger notification popups. Article popups can be disabled in Settings → Display.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.b2d4e9e6: Build your inaugural first-team roster this winter: FA Special Quota (signings without compensation players), Expansion Draft (1 player from each existing club), and Foreign Players (4 players + 1 expansion club perk).
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.b30ec6b2: Track your payroll budget and remaining expansion funds while deciding. A budget tracker appears on each decision screen.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.05b1ef2d: Your club plays no games this year. Spectate the league's pennant race while preparing for the upcoming fall draft.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.ff8c23b6: Advance time with top buttons: 1 Day, 1 Week, 1 Month, or Rest of Season. Follow the league in Standings, Stats, and Games tabs.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.f6d652f4: The "Draft Prospects" tab contains upcoming draft candidates and scouting reports. Scout targets for your priority picks in advance.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.64b64455: Advance through fall baseball with "Run Postseason", then click "Advance to Next Season" to enter the winter offseason.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.39773700: Offseason decisions appear in chronological sequence. Resolving them advances the calendar to next year's Opening Day.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.4298c442: This season your club competes exclusively in the Futures League (minors). Your first-team debut takes place in 2028.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.6c438e3b: Young players develop with playing time. Assign top prospects to the Futures active roster in My Club → Roster, and keep depth players training in the Reserve Squad (3rd team).
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.91fefcd5: Review minor league standings in Overview and game recaps/alerts in News.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.d47243dc: The trade deadline closes July 31. Address positional weaknesses before first-team play begins.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.67a92d65: The parent company sets annual performance, attendance, and financial targets, evaluating you after the season. Check them in My Club → Club Operations → Parent Company.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.04ff269b: Optionally enable AI rewriting of articles using your personal API key (Settings → AI Articles).
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.22540441: Overview: Standings, budget, and clubhouse morale. Roster: First-Team, Futures, and Reserve squad management (delegate to manager or manage manually). Lineup: Defensive positions and batting orders at a glance.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.16a15ffc: News: Articles, interviews, chronology, achievements, and notifications. Club Operations: Parent company goals, finances, tickets/marketing, staff, and ballpark.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.b2daa3dd: Manage trades (July 31 deadline, real-time partner acceptance feedback), releases, waivers, free agency, foreign player replacements (up to 2 per season, through August 15), and transfer news.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.a36d7871: Use "Player Search" to filter all players across the league by position, age, rating, and contract status to identify trade targets.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.606c4551: Controls First-Team, Futures, and Reserve Squad assignments and first-team registrations. By default, the manager reshuffles the roster every 10 days. Switching to "Manual Management" lets you control promotions, demotions, bullpen roles, and platoons, with unassigned spots filled by the manager.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.343041b0: Click any player name to open their player card. Change uniform numbers or send players showing suspicious markers for internal drug testing. Player releases are handled in the Market tab.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.efb78ac4: View the manager's default lineups (vs. RHP and LHP starters), starting rotation order, and bullpen roles at a glance.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.b006f096: Use the "GM Lineup Card" to lock specific batting orders, fielding positions, and rotation spots. Unlocked slots and absences due to injury or national team call-ups are filled by the manager.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.b5ea13c8: Send players to private training facilities in the US or Japan for several weeks. Costs are paid from club funds; in-season participants cannot play in games while away.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.10bd5acb: Younger players with substantial remaining potential gain the largest benefits. Development results appear upon return here and in News.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.f1eec6ea: The parent company assigns annual targets and evaluates post-season. Corporate subsidies are finalized on Opening Day; surplus funds roll into club reserves for FA bonuses, construction, and player training.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.8da0e2d1: Attendance & Tickets: Lowering prices drives attendance and concession/merchandise revenue; raising prices boosts yield per ticket. Consistently sold-out clubs can raise prices. Season tickets yield upfront Opening Day revenue at a discount, guaranteeing attendance regardless of team form.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.3876829b: Ballpark seating expansions, fence renovations, stadium upgrades, and training facilities are commissioned in the winter. Staff (manager, coaches, scouts, trainers, analysts) can be replaced each winter.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.60b38b94: Configure Display (brightness, font size, rating palette), Game (difficulty, tutorial), Club Names, Saves, and AI Articles all in one place.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.ab168865: For long careers, download save backups periodically with "Download Current Save File". On iOS/iPadOS, adding to Home Screen prevents browser cache purges.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.8b8abdc0: Contains terminology, league rules, screen guides, and FAQs. Expand "About this Decision" on any prompt to review key takeaways.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.1a48958f: Review consensus rankings, scouting grades, and amateur stats for upcoming draft prospects. Click a player to view their scouting report on the right (or below on narrow screens).
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.cfca7d2c: You have arrived in the first team. The manager manages active rosters automatically, or you can switch to Manual Management under Roster anytime.
ui.tutorial.rULES.body.5f806a2b: Annual parent company evaluations and winter decision cycles will continue, with major news alerted via popup. Best of luck, GM!
